_comment: Containment guard for the Claude Code arm. Passed with --settings so it lives OUTSIDE the folder the agent can edit. It is the translation of config/opencode_run.json's permission block into Claude Code's vocabulary; the two files must be read side by side, because keeping the two arms' freedoms EQUAL is the whole point of the comparison. Claude Code confines its file tools to the working directory by default, which is what bnbcode expresses as external_directory deny-by-default -- so the run folder needs no allow rule. Like bnbcode's bash deny list, the Bash rules below are a guardrail against an accident, NOT a sandbox: Bash is not path-gated in either harness and `python -c` reaches the same effect.

permissions._comment: acceptEdits plus an explicit Bash allow is what makes the run unattended. Plain acceptEdits auto-accepts edits but still PROMPTS ON EVERY BASH CALL, which wedges an unattended run immediately -- measured, not assumed. defaultMode is deliberately not bypassPermissions: that would skip the very checks these deny rules are made of.

_comment_claudemd: Without this, a CLAUDE.md sitting anywhere above the run folder is injected into the agent's context and silently becomes part of the experimental condition -- different for every site. Exclude everything above the run directory.
